  R_max: DM Mass: Integrated Dark Mass via theory formula [fraction of M_b]
  R_max: DM Mass/M_b: Ratio of Dark Mass to Total Baryons
  R_max: DM Mass/Total Gas: Ratio of Dark Mass to Integrated Gas Mass
  R_max: DM Mass/Total Baryons: Ratio of Dark Mass to all baryons
  analytic:  halo gas added to the baryons in DM calculation, to R_200 [M_sun]
  analytic:  halo dm mass added (no truncation, to R_200 [M_sun])
  analytic:  halo gas mass added (truncated at R_max [M_sun])
  analytic:  halo dm mass added (truncated at R_max [M_sun])

  R_max: DM Mass: Integrated Dark Mass via theory formula [fraction of M_b]
  R_max: DM Mass/M_b: Ratio of Dark Mass to Total Baryons
  R_max: DM Mass/Total Gas: Ratio of Dark Mass to Integrated Gas Mass
  R_max: DM Mass/Total Baryons: Ratio of Dark Mass to all baryons
  analytic:  halo gas added to the baryons in DM calculation, to R_200 [M_sun]
  analytic:  halo dm mass added (no truncation, to R_200 [M_sun])
  analytic:  halo gas mass added (truncated at R_max [M_sun])
  analytic:  halo dm mass added (truncated at R_max [M_sun])

  R_max: DM Mass/M_b: Ratio of Dark Mass to Total Baryons
  R_max: DM Mass/Total Gas: Ratio of Dark Mass to Integrated Gas Mass
  R_max: DM Mass/Total Baryons: Ratio of Dark Mass to all baryons
  analytic:  halo gas added to the baryons in DM calculation, to R_200 [M_sun]
  analytic:  halo dm mass added (no truncation, to R_200 [M_sun])
  analytic:  halo gas mass added (truncated at R_max [M_sun])
  analytic:  halo dm mass added (truncated at R_max [M_sun])
